title: Square Enix announces Dragon Quest RPG: The Cursed Tree and the Chosen Isle, a new Dragon Quest command RPG for iOS and Android; announcement trailer premieres 10 Nov 15:00 Dubai
game: Dragon Quest RPG: The Cursed Tree and the Chosen Isle
why: A new Dragon Quest game, announced by surprise, with its trailer due in under 36 hours; Dragon Quest is a first-rank series. Nothing is announced on release date or price.

angle.hook: Dragon Quest has a new game, announced by surprise for smartphones, with nothing yet on date or price
angle.why_now: Announced 9 Nov; the trailer premieres 10 Nov 15:00 Dubai
angle.what_it_means_here: A new Dragon Quest command RPG on iOS and Android, so playable on any phone in the Gulf, but only the trailer will show more
angle.payoff: what is not announced: date and price; trailer tomorrow 15:00 Dubai
